profile.headline: Wealth Management Advisor at Congruity Financial
profile.summary:
Highly motivated, fun, energetic, passionate person who loves helping families gain financial independence.

Building a world class financial firm in the heart of Tucson AZ with other like minded visionary’s and entrepreneurial spirited people. 

If you are self driven, energetic, not willing to settle, aspire to leaving a lasting impact on peoples lives, want to take control of your time and life then let's talk and build a partnership.

positions.title: Wealth Management Advisor
positions.description:
Educating families on proper protection of income, assets, estate planning, college saving, retirement benefits.

Educating Small business the importance of setting up benefits and protection in  key employees, deferred compensation, buy sell agreements.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer/Owvner
positions.description:
As  web developer I am committed in providing custom solutions based on customers needs and goals. I look forward to working with small business owners, start ups, or any entrepreneur who is ready to expand their business and utilize the many tools the web has to offer. Here is some examples of what I bring

Brand development, web site traffic growth, web site UI and advertising revenue. Developed brand strategy and statistics systems.

Strategic Consulting, including business plan & sales strategy development.

Responsive website designs, focusing on users goals creating an easy to use interface experience
Designing promotional resources such as business cards, flyers, mailers etc, short film media/animation

positions.title: Software Developer/QA Testing
positions.description:
Design and implement Test Plans, Test Cases. Test all software based on requirements and test plans. 

Test methodologies used include black box testing, white box testing, exploratory testing, scripted testing.

Database testing: Update, Create, database and tables. Reporting testing, Left Join, Inner Join, Right Join, Data Query, Attach/Detach Database.

Report on all bug issues and maintain log reports on progress. Developed government software in VB.Net, provided designed for User Interface. Created zip file program.
